title: Bromine in water
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: In water, bromine addition to ethene forms a halohydrin. One carbon gains Br and the other gains OH; the double bond becomes a single bond.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethene under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethene is treated with Br₂ in water. Which major organic product forms after workup? In water, bromine addition to ethene forms a halohydrin. One carbon gains Br and the other gains OH; the double bond becomes a single bond.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
